episodes.title: Campeggio Crystal
episodes.overview: Pam non riesce ad accettare la morte di Jason. Mentre fugge dal presente, si ritrova ben presto di fronte al suo passato.

episodes.title: Parte 2
episodes.overview: Pam partecipa a un seminario dove un guru la spinge al limite. Qualcosa sta proteggendo Grace.

episodes.title: Parte III
episodes.overview: Gli abitanti della città vanno a caccia di orsi andando contro all'ordinanaza. Pam affronta Valerie credendo che Grace sia in pericolo.

episodes.title: A New Beginning
episodes.overview: Willow looks for her friends; Pam returns to work at the camp alongside a group of new counselors.

episodes.title: The New Blood
episodes.overview: Camp Crystal Lake reopens despite the mounting death toll; Pam discovers life-changing news.

episodes.title: Kill Them, Mommy
episodes.overview: The counselors' drug trip takes a chilling turn; Briana receives a mysterious envelope.

episodes.title: Friday…
episodes.overview: In the past, a young Jason shows alarming symptoms that lead Pam to question life as she knows it.

episodes.title: The Final Chapter
episodes.overview: Elias arrives in Crystal Lake determined to find his family; Levon and Elias have a heated clash.
